records.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT seller_id) AS seller_count
FROM sellers

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS unique_customers
FROM customers

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.product_id) AS total_products
FROM products p

SELECT ROUND(AVG(r.review_score), 2) AS avg_review_score
FROM reviews r

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS valid_order_count
FROM orders o
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')

SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.freight_value), 2) AS total_freight
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')

SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS total_sales
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')

SELECT ROUND(
    SUM(CASE WHEN r.review_score >= 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2
) AS positive_review_rate
FROM reviews r
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = r.order_id
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.product_category_name) AS category_count
FROM products p

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_state) AS state_count
FROM customers

SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.price) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 2) AS avg_order_value
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')

SELECT ROUND(AVG(DATE_DIFF('day', o.order_purchase_timestamp, o.order_delivered_customer_date)), 2) AS avg_delivery_days
FROM orders o
WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
  AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL

SELECT ROUND(
    SUM(CASE WHEN r.review_score <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*),
    2
) AS negative_review_rate
FROM reviews r
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = r.order_id
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')

SELECT AVG(p.payment_installments) AS avg_installments
FROM payments p
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = p.order_id
WHERE p.payment_type = 'credit_card'
  AND o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')

SELECT 
    ROUND(
        SUM(CASE WHEN p.payment_type = 'credit_card' THEN p.payment_value ELSE 0 END) / 
        SUM(p.payment_value) * 100, 
        2
    ) AS credit_card_payment_ratio
FROM payments p
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = p.order_id
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')

SELECT 
    ROUND(
        SUM(CASE WHEN p.payment_installments > 1 THEN p.payment_value ELSE 0 END) / 
        SUM(p.payment_value) * 100, 
        2
    ) AS installment_payment_percentage
FROM payments p
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = p.order_id
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')

SELECT MAX(payment_value) AS max_single_payment
FROM payments

SELECT ROUND(MAX(oi.price), 2) AS max_single_item_price
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')

SELECT COUNT(*) AS delivered_orders
FROM orders
WHERE order_status = 'delivered'

SELECT MIN(o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS earliest_order,
       MAX(o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS latest_order
FROM orders o

SELECT ROUND(AVG(oi.freight_value), 2) AS avg_freight_value
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')

SELECT COUNT(*) AS canceled_orders
FROM orders
WHERE order_status = 'canceled'

SELECT ROUND(AVG(item_count), 2) AS avg_items_per_order
FROM (
    SELECT o.order_id, COUNT(oi.order_item_id) AS item_count
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
    GROUP BY o.order_id
) sub

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_reviews
FROM reviews

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS distinct_orders_with_reviews
FROM orders o
JOIN reviews r ON r.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')

SELECT c.customer_state,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS total_revenue
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC
LIMIT 3

SELECT ct.product_category_name_english AS category,
       COUNT(*) AS item_volume
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
JOIN category_translation ct ON ct.product_category_name = p.product_category_name
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY item_volume DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT ct.product_category_name_english AS category,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS total_revenue
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
JOIN category_translation ct ON ct.product_category_name = p.product_category_name
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT s.seller_id,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS total_revenue
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN sellers s ON s.seller_id = oi.seller_id
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
GROUP BY s.seller_id
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT c.customer_city,
       COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_unique_id) AS unique_customer_count
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY unique_customer_count DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT p.payment_type,
       COUNT(*) AS payment_count,
       ROUND(SUM(p.payment_value), 2) AS total_amount
FROM payments p
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = p.order_id
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
GROUP BY p.payment_type
ORDER BY payment_count DESC

SELECT c.customer_state,
       ROUND(AVG(r.review_score), 2) AS avg_review_score,
       COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_volume
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN reviews r ON r.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
GROUP BY c.customer_state
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) > 100
ORDER BY avg_review_score ASC
LIMIT 3

SELECT ct.product_category_name_english AS category,
       COUNT(*) AS total_reviews,
       SUM(CASE WHEN r.review_score <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS negative_reviews,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN r.review_score <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS negative_rate
FROM reviews r
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = r.order_id
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
JOIN category_translation ct ON ct.product_category_name = p.product_category_name
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
GROUP BY 1
HAVING COUNT(*) > 100
ORDER BY negative_rate DESC
LIMIT 3

SELECT c.customer_state,
       ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (o.order_delivered_customer_date - o.order_purchase_timestamp)) / 86400.0), 2) AS avg_delivery_days
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
  AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY avg_delivery_days DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT o2.customer_id) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT o1.customer_id), 4) AS repurchase_rate
FROM orders o1
LEFT JOIN orders o2 ON o1.customer_id = o2.customer_id
  AND o2.order_purchase_timestamp > o1.order_purchase_timestamp
  AND o2.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
WHERE o1.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')

SELECT s.seller_id,
       COUNT(*) AS negative_review_count
FROM reviews r
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = r.order_id
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN sellers s ON s.seller_id = oi.seller_id
WHERE r.review_score <= 2
  AND o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
GROUP BY s.seller_id
ORDER BY negative_review_count DESC
LIMIT 3

SELECT ct.product_category_name_english AS category,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS total_sales
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
JOIN category_translation ct ON ct.product_category_name = p.product_category_name
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
  AND c.customer_state = 'SP'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY total_sales DESC
LIMIT 3

SELECT ct.product_category_name_english AS category,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.price) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 2) AS avg_order_value
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
JOIN category_translation ct ON ct.product_category_name = p.product_category_name
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY avg_order_value DESC
LIMIT 3

SELECT c.customer_state,
       COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_volume
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY order_volume DESC
LIMIT 5

WITH top_categories AS (
    SELECT p.product_category_name,
           ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS total_revenue
    FROM order_items oi
    JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
    JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
    WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
    GROUP BY p.product_category_name
    ORDER BY total_revenue DESC
    LIMIT 3
)
SELECT ct.product_category_name_english AS category,
       ROUND(AVG(r.review_score), 2) AS avg_review_score
FROM top_categories tc
JOIN products p ON p.product_category_name = tc.product_category_name
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN reviews r ON r.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN category_translation ct ON ct.product_category_name = tc.product_category_name
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
GROUP BY ct.product_category_name_english
ORDER BY avg_review_score DESC

SELECT c.customer_state,
       AVG(DATE_DIFF('day', o.order_purchase_timestamp, o.order_delivered_customer_date)) AS avg_delivery_days,
       COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_volume
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
  AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) > 100
ORDER BY avg_delivery_days ASC
LIMIT 3

SELECT ct.product_category_name_english AS category,
       ROUND(AVG(oi.freight_value), 2) AS avg_freight_per_order
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
JOIN category_translation ct ON ct.product_category_name = p.product_category_name
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY avg_freight_per_order DESC
LIMIT 3

SELECT c.customer_unique_id,
       COUNT(oi.order_item_id) AS total_items
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id
ORDER BY total_items DESC
LIMIT 3

SELECT s.seller_id,
       ROUND(AVG(r.review_score), 2) AS avg_review_score
FROM sellers s
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.seller_id = s.seller_id
JOIN reviews r ON r.order_id = oi.order_id
GROUP BY s.seller_id
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 50
ORDER BY avg_review_score DESC
LIMIT 3

SELECT ct.product_category_name_english AS category,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS revenue
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
JOIN category_translation ct ON ct.product_category_name = p.product_category_name
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2018-01-01'
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2019-01-01'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY revenue DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT c.customer_state,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN p.payment_type = 'boleto' THEN p.payment_value ELSE 0 END), 2) AS boleto_amount,
       ROUND(SUM(p.payment_value), 2) AS total_amount,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN p.payment_type = 'boleto' THEN p.payment_value ELSE 0 END) / SUM(p.payment_value) * 100, 2) AS boleto_pct
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN payments p ON p.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY boleto_pct DESC
LIMIT 3

SELECT ct.product_category_name_english AS category,
       COUNT(r.review_id) AS review_count,
       ROUND(COUNT(r.review_id) FILTER (WHERE r.review_comment_message IS NOT NULL AND r.review_comment_message != '') * 100.0 / COUNT(r.review_id), 2) AS text_review_ratio
FROM reviews r
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = r.order_id
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
JOIN category_translation ct ON ct.product_category_name = p.product_category_name
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
GROUP BY 1
HAVING COUNT(r.review_id) > 100
ORDER BY text_review_ratio DESC
LIMIT 3

SELECT ct.product_category_name_english AS category,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.freight_value) / SUM(oi.price) * 100, 2) AS freight_ratio_pct
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
JOIN category_translation ct ON ct.product_category_name = p.product_category_name
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY freight_ratio_pct DESC
LIMIT 3

SELECT c.customer_state,
       ROUND(AVG(DATE_DIFF('day', o.order_purchase_timestamp, o.order_delivered_customer_date)), 2) AS avg_delivery_days
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
  AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY avg_delivery_days DESC
LIMIT 5

WITH state_payment AS (
    SELECT c.customer_state,
           p.payment_type,
           SUM(p.payment_value) AS total_payment_value
    FROM orders o
    JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    JOIN payments p ON p.order_id = o.order_id
    WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
    GROUP BY 1, 2
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT *,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_state ORDER BY total_payment_value DESC) AS rn
    FROM state_payment
)
SELECT customer_state,
       payment_type,
       ROUND(total_payment_value, 2) AS total_payment_value
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY customer_state

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_purchase_timestamp)::DATE AS month,
       COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS valid_order_count
FROM orders o
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2018-01-01'
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2019-01-01'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_purchase_timestamp)::DATE AS month,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS revenue
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2018-01-01'
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2019-01-01'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS year,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS revenue
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2017-01-01'
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2019-01-01'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_purchase_timestamp)::DATE AS month,
       ROUND(AVG(r.review_score), 2) AS avg_review_score
FROM orders o
JOIN reviews r ON r.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2017-01-01'
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2019-01-01'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

WITH latest_date AS (
    SELECT MAX(order_purchase_timestamp) AS max_ts
    FROM orders
    WHERE order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS valid_order_count
FROM orders o
CROSS JOIN latest_date ld
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= ld.max_ts - INTERVAL '3 months'
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp <= ld.max_ts

SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS year,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS revenue
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

WITH latest_date AS (
    SELECT MAX(order_purchase_timestamp) AS max_ts
    FROM orders
    WHERE order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
)
SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_purchase_timestamp)::DATE AS month,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS revenue
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
CROSS JOIN latest_date ld
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE_TRUNC('month', ld.max_ts - INTERVAL '11 months')
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp <= ld.max_ts
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN o.order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2018-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2018-04-01' THEN 'Q1'
        WHEN o.order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2018-04-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2018-07-01' THEN 'Q2'
    END AS quarter,
    ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS revenue
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2018-01-01'
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2018-07-01'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

WITH first_orders AS (
    SELECT customer_id,
           MIN(order_purchase_timestamp) AS first_purchase_time
    FROM orders
    WHERE order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
    GROUP BY customer_id
)
SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', first_purchase_time)::DATE AS month,
       COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS new_customers
FROM first_orders
WHERE first_purchase_time >= DATE '2018-01-01'
  AND first_purchase_time < DATE '2019-01-01'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT CONCAT(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp), '-Q', EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp)) AS quarter,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS revenue
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT DAYNAME(o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS day_of_week,
       COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_volume
FROM orders o
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY order_volume DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH yearly_revenue AS (
    SELECT
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS year,
        ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS revenue
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
      AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2017-01-01'
      AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2019-01-01'
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
    ROUND(((r2018.revenue - r2017.revenue) / r2017.revenue) * 100, 2) AS growth_rate_percent
FROM
    (SELECT revenue FROM yearly_revenue WHERE year = 2017) r2017,
    (SELECT revenue FROM yearly_revenue WHERE year = 2018) r2018

WITH last_date AS (
    SELECT MAX(order_purchase_timestamp) AS max_ts
    FROM orders
    WHERE order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
)
SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_purchase_timestamp)::DATE AS month,
       COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_volume
FROM orders o
CROSS JOIN last_date ld
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE_TRUNC('month', ld.max_ts - INTERVAL '5 months')
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < DATE_TRUNC('month', ld.max_ts) + INTERVAL '1 month'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT EXTRACT(HOUR FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS hour_of_day,
       COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count
FROM orders o
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY order_count DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH monthly_revenue AS (
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_purchase_timestamp)::DATE AS month,
           ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS revenue
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
      AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2018-08-01'
      AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2018-10-01'
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT ROUND((sep.revenue - aug.revenue) / aug.revenue * 100, 2) AS pct_change
FROM (SELECT revenue FROM monthly_revenue WHERE month = DATE '2018-08-01') aug,
     (SELECT revenue FROM monthly_revenue WHERE month = DATE '2018-09-01') sep

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_purchase_timestamp)::DATE AS month,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS revenue
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2017-01-01'
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2018-01-01'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY revenue DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_purchase_timestamp)::DATE AS month,
       ROUND(AVG(DATE_DIFF('day', o.order_purchase_timestamp, o.order_delivered_customer_date)), 2) AS avg_delivery_days
FROM orders o
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
  AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2018-01-01'
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2019-01-01'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT CONCAT('Q', EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp)) AS quarter,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS revenue
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2017-01-01'
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2018-01-01'
GROUP BY EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp)
ORDER BY EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp)

WITH yearly_category_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS year,
        ct.product_category_name_english AS category,
        ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS revenue
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
    JOIN category_translation ct ON ct.product_category_name = p.product_category_name
    WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
      AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2017-01-01'
      AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2019-01-01'
    GROUP BY 1, 2
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        year,
        category,
        revenue,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY year ORDER BY revenue DESC) AS rn
    FROM yearly_category_sales
)
SELECT year, category, revenue
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 3
ORDER BY year, rn

WITH review_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        CASE 
            WHEN r.review_creation_date >= DATE '2017-09-01' AND r.review_creation_date < DATE '2018-09-01' THEN 'previous_year'
            WHEN r.review_creation_date >= DATE '2018-09-01' AND r.review_creation_date < DATE '2019-09-01' THEN 'last_year'
        END AS period,
        r.review_score
    FROM reviews r
    JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = r.order_id
    WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
      AND r.review_creation_date >= DATE '2017-09-01'
      AND r.review_creation_date < DATE '2019-09-01'
)
SELECT 
    period,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN review_score >= 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS positive_rate
FROM review_stats
WHERE period IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY period
ORDER BY period
